segments.title: The Silent Leakage Problem
segments.text: 3 to 7 percent of every rupee earned on Myntra, Amazon and Flipkart quietly leaks out. Miscalculated commissions. Unbilled returns. Misapplied logistics fees. On a 100 crore business, that's up to 7 crores of pure margin — gone every year.

segments.title: Meet Fundle Finance OS
segments.text: Fundle Finance OS. A no-code, self-serve marketplace reconciliation platform. Built for finance and operations teams who refuse to accept leakage as the cost of doing business.

segments.title: Ingest — one drop, sixty seconds
segments.text: It starts here. Drop your Myntra sales file. Drop the matching settlement file. Fundle's parser normalises tens of thousands of order lines — sales, returns, DTOs, RTOs and cancellations — into one canonical ledger. Twenty-one thousand rows. Sixty seconds. Zero manual clean-up.

segments.title: No-code rule engine — Finance owns it
segments.text: This is the heart of Fundle. Every business rule you need — commission slabs, GT logistics, fixed fees, zone-based return fees — is fully configurable through a no-code editor. Change any commission percentage inline. Round-trip through Excel — download the config, edit in a spreadsheet, upload back. Every version tracked. Finance owns the logic, end to end. Zero engineers required.

segments.title: Expected fee engine
segments.text: Fundle now computes expected settlement for every single order. Commission on NSV minus GT. Fixed fees by price slab. Zone and level return fees. Pre-GST and GST are split cleanly. Strict rule matching — no fallbacks, no dummy defaults. Every line is drill-through and audit-ready.

segments.title: Reconciliation
segments.text: Upload the settlement report, pick a month, and one click reconciles actual against expected — line by line. Component-level match. Configurable tolerances. Discrepancies surface — ranked by financial impact, ageing and severity.

segments.title: Recovery case management
segments.text: Every rupee of leakage becomes a trackable recovery case. Total recoverable, live. Recovered, ageing, ownership, evidence, notes — a full audit trail. Auto-create cases from open discrepancies in a single click. Nothing gets forgotten between spreadsheets and inboxes.

segments.title: AI Financial Intelligence
segments.text: And on top, Fundle's AI Insights engine. It reads your entire reconciliation dataset and returns a single marketplace health score. Mapping, leakage, margin, recovery — each scored, each drill-able. Then a plain-English morning brief your CFO can act on in minutes. Finance intelligence, on autopilot.
